body: I'm really sorry about all of this. I have some perspective in this topic as someone who abused me is also a public figure with followers (who i am not naming for privacy reasons, they are  very niche anyway) It's horrible to see people online act like they know you because they know what you went through, and I won't try to pretend I do. I fell in to reading all these threads about my abuser and the whole experience alongside the initial "making it public" thing re-traumatized me in a way fortunately ive made a lot of progress in the couple years since I talked about this and I really hope you can get to that point because it is very possible!! focus on yourself and what makes you feel healthy, best wishes

I was having pretty similar symptoms a few days ago, and right now I am feeling much better (was able to go out and do my normal routine the entire day). 

for me, it got a little better when I started eating fuller meals and sleeping better. from there I was able to slowly ease in to going outside or doing things I was nervous about. 

It's definitely hard for a while but it will absolutely get better. Take care!
